summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-REX 2X Long PURR Daily Target ETF (KATT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Hyperliquid Strategies Inc. (NASDAQ: PURR), less fees and expenses, through derivatives such as swap agreements. KATT was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
